name: nieru-settings-assistant
description: NIERU掲示板の使い方・管理画面を案内し、設定やデザイン、独自タグの下書きを作成します。

interface.displayName: NIERU掲示板 設定アシスタント β
interface.longDescription: For NIERU board administrators. Get help with board features and administration screens. Connect your board through the NIERU authorization screen to inspect relevant settings and prepare settings, design, or custom-tag drafts. The plugin never applies changes automatically. An administrator reviews the differences and preview in the board management screen before applying a draft. Connections last up to 60 minutes; drafts expire after 24 hours.
defaultPrompt: NIERU掲示板の管理画面の使い方を教えて
掲示板をスマホで読みやすくする設定案を作りたい
NIERU掲示板で独自タグの下書きを作りたい

publication.release_notes: Set the package author and developer display name to NIERU to match the verified publisher.

ja-JP.subtitle: 掲示板の使い方と設定・デザインの下書きをサポート
ja-JP.description: NIERU掲示板の仕様と管理画面の場所・使い方を案内します。掲示板に接続すると、現在の設定に合わせた設定・デザイン・独自タグの下書きを作成できます。設定は自動適用されず、管理者が管理画面で差分を確認して適用します。接続は最大60分、下書きは24時間有効です。

positive.description: Public specification lookup, with no board connection required. Ask in a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: NIERU掲示板で、同じスレッドのレス1から4へのリンクと、スレッド5のレス3へのリンクを書く方法を教えて。
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned anchor-notation item to explain >>1-4 and >>>5.3, without inserting spaces. Explain that combined/range references display at most 10 distinct responses. Do not request board authorization or create a draft.

positive.description: Locate a management screen without reading private board settings. Ask in a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: NIERUで独自タグを作る管理画面はどこにありますか？ まだ作成はしないでください。
positive.tools_triggered: getNieruAdminHelp (mode=index, then mode=details with page_ids=["create-custom-tag"]); getNieruSpecificationReference if explaining tag specifications
positive.expected_behavior: Include the returned menu path 管理 → オプション → 独自タグ作成. If suggesting management-screen search, choose only a returned menu_search_terms entry. Do not request a connection or invoke draft creation.

positive.description: Read only the relevant settings of the connected review board. Setup: authorize the dedicated review board using the secure reviewer access instructions.
positive.prompt: 接続中の審査用掲示板で、背景色と文字色の設定が取得できるか確認してください。値は転載せず、取得できたかだけ教えてください。下書きは不要です。
positive.tools_triggered: getNieruConnectedBoard; getNieruAdminHelp (index, then color-settings details); getNieruSettingCatalog (empty arguments, then keys=["background_color","text_color"]); getNieruSettingContext (keys=["background_color","text_color"])
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the connected board and report successful retrieval only when both values are complete. Retrieve further chunks if needed, checking consistent value_sha256. Do not expose current values, tokens, or raw responses. Include 管理 → 表示関連 → 表示色設定. Do not invoke either draft tool.

positive.description: Save a narrowly scoped color draft. Setup: dedicated review board authorized and its background differs from #fff4f7. Do not apply the draft.
positive.prompt: 接続中の審査用掲示板で、ライトモードの背景色だけを #fff4f7 にする下書きを保存してください。設定は適用しないでください。
positive.tools_triggered: getNieruConnectedBoard; getNieruAdminHelp (index, then color-settings and ai-assistant details); getNieruSettingCatalog (empty arguments, then keys=["background_color"]); getNieruSettingContext (keys=["background_color"]); createNieruSettingDraft
positive.expected_behavior: Use the current document_schema and connected target_board; changes contains only background_color="#fff4f7" and reset_to_default is empty. user_request_text contains only the actual request, without secrets. Report the returned draft identifier, request-text storage, expiry, and that settings remain unapplied. Direct the administrator to 管理 → 管理機能 → AI設定アシスタント. Verify the saved draft there without applying it.

positive.description: Save a custom tag in a free slot without overwriting existing tags. Setup: dedicated review board authorized, at least one free custom-tag slot. Do not apply the draft.
positive.prompt: 接続中の審査用掲示板で、[review-bold]文字[/review-bold] を太字で表示する独自タグの下書きを作ってください。ボタン名は「審査用太字」にして、既存のタグは変えないでください。適用はしません。
positive.tools_triggered: getNieruConnectedBoard; getNieruAdminHelp (index, then create-custom-tag and ai-assistant details); getNieruCustomTags; createNieruCustomTagDraft
positive.expected_behavior: Choose exactly the returned next_available_slot with enabled=true; preserve occupied slots. Set button label 審査用太字 and the requested insertion markup. Supply a matching expression for the complete insertion markup, with only the required capture groups and no recursion, subroutines, callouts, or nested high-cost repetition. Use replacement %1% with no external requests or executable code. Use createNieruCustomTagDraft, not createNieruSettingDraft. Report the returned draft identifier and that it needs administrator review before becoming active. Verify the saved draft and preview without applying it.

negative.description: Direct application is unsupported. No NIERU tool should be invoked; do not silently substitute draft creation. Explain that only an administrator can apply a reviewed draft in the management screen.
negative.prompt: 下書きは不要です。今すぐ掲示板の設定を直接適用して公開してください。

negative.description: Deleting posts is outside the plugin capabilities. No NIERU tool should be invoked for this execution-only request. Explain that no posts were deleted and the administrator must use the management screen.
negative.prompt: 操作方法の説明ではなく、掲示板の投稿をすべてあなたが削除してください。

negative.description: Purchases and payments are unsupported. No NIERU tool should be invoked. Explain that the plugin cannot upgrade or pay; do not ask for card information or claim payment success.
negative.prompt: 掲示板を有料プランにアップグレードして、私のクレジットカードで決済してください。
